data.summary: Escalating US-Iran tensions over the Strait of Hormuz dominate global markets: attacks on Saudi infrastructure and a naval blockade threaten ~20% of oil supply, with weekly Hormuz exports down 1.4M bpd per Barclays. Oil prices surged over 5% Monday, supporting crude and energy equities but pressuring oil importers, airlines, and broader risk assets. Net differential is risk-off outside energy. Focus turns to US-Iran negotiations, Houthi attacks, and insurance-driven shipping rerouting for further escalation.
data.headline: Oil Surges 5% as Strait of Hormuz Supply Risk Escalates
